## Change

Describe the paper/claim, extractor, execution boundary, comparison policy, or documentation behavior changed.

## Evidence

- [ ] The claim is bounded and linked to its paper location.
- [ ] Official code/data and license/access conditions are documented.
- [ ] Observations come from run-bound machine-readable output.
- [ ] Comparison, units, seeds, budgets, and limitations are predeclared.
- [ ] No whole-paper truth, causality, or generalization claim is implied.

## Safety and privacy

- [ ] Execution remains preview-first and isolated.
- [ ] Network/write/resource capabilities are no broader than necessary.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, paywall bypass, or CAPTCHA bypass are included.
- [ ] Manual tables/images cannot directly receive a reproduced status.

## Validation

- [ ] Added or updated a regression test.
- [ ] Ran the commands in `AGENTS.md`.
- [ ] Stated whether provenance, extractors, comparison, credentials, network, or privacy boundaries change.
